name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the technical intricacies of race cars. Growing up in Porto, he spent countless hours dismantling and reassembling anything mechanical he could get his hands on. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he quickly found his way into the world of racing. Prior to joining Dick Johnson Racing, Ricardo honed his skills in various smaller teams, steadily building a reputation for his sharp eye for detail and methodical approach to problem-solving. 

At Dick Johnson Racing, Ricardo applies his engineering background to ensure that every component meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. He's known for his creative solutions to complex issues and isn't afraid to challenge established norms if it means finding a better way. Ricardo believes that effective quality control is not just about identifying problems, but about proactively preventing them, and he is constantly seeking ways to improve the team's processes and procedures. His ambition is to eventually lead a quality control department, driving innovation and efficiency within a top-tier racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and focused gaze.
